description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `ImmutableFunctionExpression` that implements `FunctionExpression`. It specifies supported pipeline functions for processing expressions, provides mechanisms for resolving and supporting function names, and maintains a singleton instance. It appears to be part of an internal model representing placeholder functions in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableFunctionExpression
classes.description: An immutable singleton implementation of FunctionExpression that supports specific pipeline functions used in expression processing within placeholders.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix constant used in expression identifiers.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list of supported function names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given expression name is supported based on its prefix.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a string expression into a PipelineElement by identifying and applying the corresponding pipeline function.
